description: Gatsby Node configuration file for a FreeCodeCamp project, handling node creation, page generation, webpack configuration, and Babel setup.

methods.name: onCreateNode
methods.description: Creates a 'slug' node field for MarkdownRemark nodes, excluding LICENSE files.

methods.name: createPages
methods.description: Generates pages based on GraphQL data, including challenge nodes and markdown files, with environment validation.

methods.name: onCreateWebpackConfig
methods.description: Configures Webpack with plugins and fallbacks, including Monaco editor support during non-SSR stages.

methods.name: onCreateBabelConfig
methods.description: Sets Babel plugins for proposal features.
